@_styled
def plot_field_lines(field: VectorField3D, lines: list[FieldLine] | None = None,
                     seeds: np.ndarray | None = None, ax=None, view: str = "3d",
                     color_by: str = "apex", norm: Normalize | None = None,
                     highlight=None, title: str | None = None,
                     elev: float = 35, azim: float = -65, lw: float = 0.9,
                     colorbar: bool = False):
    """Draw field lines over Bz(z=0).

    view : ``"3d"``, ``"top"`` (xy projection) or ``"side"`` (xz projection).
    color_by : ``"apex"`` (maximum height, blue ramp), ``"seed"`` (highlights the
        numbered seeds of ``highlight``; the rest in grey) or ``"closed"``
        (blue = closed, orange = leaves the domain).
    norm : height normalisation; pass a shared one when comparing models.
    highlight : indices of the seeds to highlight (``color_by="seed"``). By
        default 6 well-spread seeds.
    """
    if lines is None:
        if seeds is None:
            raise ValueError("Da 'lines' o 'seeds'")
        lines = trace_field_lines(field, seeds)
    if norm is None:
        norm = Normalize(0, max(max(l.apex for l in lines), 1e-9))
    if color_by == "seed" and highlight is None:
        highlight = spread_indices(np.array([l.seed for l in lines]), 6)
    x, y, z = field.x, field.y, field.z
    bz0 = field.bz[:, :, 0]
    vlim = _bz_vlim(bz0)
    styles = _style_for_lines(lines, color_by, norm, highlight, lw)
    order = np.argsort([s[2] for s in styles], kind="stable")  # highlighted ones last

    if view == "3d":
        if ax is None:
            fig = plt.figure(figsize=(8, 7), layout="constrained")
            ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
        ax.computed_zorder = False  # the z=0 plane always below the lines
        X, Y = np.meshgrid(x, y, indexing="ij")
        st = max(1, max(bz0.shape) // 120)
        fc = BZ_CMAP(Normalize(-vlim, vlim)(bz0))
        ax.plot_surface(X, Y, np.full_like(X, z[0]), facecolors=fc, rstride=st, cstride=st,
                        shade=False, linewidth=0, antialiased=False, zorder=0)
        p = _pil_field(bz0)
        if np.nanmin(p) < 0 < np.nanmax(p):
            ax.contour(X, Y, p, levels=[0.0], zdir="z", offset=z[0], colors=INK,
                       linewidths=1.2, zorder=1)
        for j in order:
            l, (c, w, zo, lab) = lines[j], styles[j]
            ax.plot(l.points[:, 0], l.points[:, 1], l.points[:, 2], color=c, lw=w, zorder=zo)
            if lab:
                ax.text(*l.start, lab, color=INK, fontsize=8, fontweight="bold", zorder=10)
        ax.set_xlim(x[0], x[-1])
        ax.set_ylim(y[0], y[-1])
        ax.set_zlim(z[0], z[-1])
        ax.set_box_aspect((x[-1] - x[0], y[-1] - y[0], z[-1] - z[0]))
        ax.view_init(elev=elev, azim=azim)
        ax.set_zlabel("z [Mm]")
        for a in (ax.xaxis, ax.yaxis, ax.zaxis):
            a.pane.set_facecolor(SURFACE)
            a.pane.set_edgecolor(MUTED)
            a._axinfo["grid"]["color"] = "#e6e5e1"
    else:
        if ax is None:
            _, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 6), layout="constrained")
        if view == "top":
            _draw_bz_2d(ax, x, y, bz0, vlim)
            for j in order:
                l, (c, w, zo, lab) = lines[j], styles[j]
                ax.plot(l.points[:, 0], l.points[:, 1], color=c, lw=w, zorder=zo)
                if lab:
                    ax.annotate(lab, l.start[:2], color=INK, fontsize=8, fontweight="bold",
                                zorder=10, ha="center", va="center",
                                bbox=dict(boxstyle="circle,pad=0.15", fc=SURFACE, ec=c, lw=1.2))
            ax.set_xlim(*_edges(x))
            ax.set_ylim(*_edges(y))
            ax.set_ylabel("y [Mm]")
        elif view == "side":
            ax.axhline(z[0], color=INK2, lw=0.8)
            for j in order:
                l, (c, w, zo, lab) = lines[j], styles[j]
                ax.plot(l.points[:, 0], l.points[:, 2], color=c, lw=w, zorder=zo)
            ax.set_xlim(x[0], x[-1])
            ax.set_ylim(z[0], z[-1])
            ax.set_ylabel("z [Mm]")
        else:
            raise ValueError("view debe ser '3d', 'top' o 'side'")
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
    ax.set_xlabel("x [Mm]")
    if view == "3d":
        ax.set_ylabel("y [Mm]")
    ax.set_title(field.meta.get("method", "") if title is None else title)
    if colorbar and color_by == "apex":
        plt.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm, APEX_CMAP), ax=ax, shrink=0.6,
                     label=_t("apex"))
    return ax

@_styled
def plot_comparison(models: dict[str, VectorField3D], seeds: np.ndarray,
                    views=("3d", "top", "side"), color_by: str = "apex",
                    n_highlight: int = 6, save: str | None = None,
                    panel_width: float = 4.6, **kw):
    """Grid of models (columns) × views (rows) with the same seeds.

    The height scale and the Bz scale are common to all the panels.
    ``color_by="seed"`` numbers ``n_highlight`` seeds: the same number is the
    same seed in every model, which shows how its connectivity changes.
    """
    names = list(models)
    lines = {k: trace_field_lines(v, seeds) for k, v in models.items()}
    zmax = max(l.apex for ls in lines.values() for l in ls)
    norm = Normalize(0, max(zmax, 1e-9))
    highlight = spread_indices(seeds, n_highlight) if color_by == "seed" else None

    f0 = models[names[0]]
    xext = f0.x[-1] - f0.x[0]
    yext = f0.y[-1] - f0.y[0]
    zext = f0.z[-1] - f0.z[0]
    ratios = {"3d": 0.8, "top": yext / xext, "side": max(zext / xext, 0.25)}
    hr = [ratios[v] for v in views]
    fig = plt.figure(figsize=(panel_width * len(names) + 1.2, panel_width * sum(hr) + 0.8),
                     layout="constrained")
    gs = fig.add_gridspec(len(views), len(names), height_ratios=hr)
    axes = []
    for i, v in enumerate(views):
        for j, name in enumerate(names):
            f = models[name]
            ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[i, j], projection="3d" if v == "3d" else None)
            title = ""
            if i == 0:
                title = name
                a = f.meta.get("alpha")
                if a:
                    title += f"\nα = {a:.3g} Mm⁻¹"
            plot_field_lines(f, lines=lines[name], ax=ax, view=v, color_by=color_by,
                             norm=norm, highlight=highlight, title=title, **kw)
            if j > 0 and v != "3d":
                ax.set_ylabel("")
            axes.append(ax)

    vlim = _bz_vlim(f0.bz[:, :, 0])
    fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(Normalize(-vlim, vlim), BZ_CMAP), ax=axes, shrink=0.5,
                 label=_t("bz0"), location="right")
    if color_by == "apex":
        fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(norm, APEX_CMAP), ax=axes, shrink=0.5,
                     label=_t("apex"), location="right")
    handles = _bz_legend_handles()
    if color_by == "seed":
        handles.append(Line2D([], [], color=MUTED, lw=1, label=_t("rest")))
        fig.suptitle(_t("same_seed"), fontsize=10, color=INK2)
    fig.legend(handles=handles, loc="outside lower center", ncol=len(handles), fontsize=8.5)
    if save:
        fig.savefig(save, dpi=150)
    return fig

@_styled
def plot_alpha_maps(models: dict[str, VectorField3D], z: float = 5.0,
                    vlim: float | None = None, save: str | None = None):
    """Maps of α = (∇×B)·B/B² at height ``z`` (Mm) for each model.

    Potential: α = 0. LFFF: constant α. NLFFF: α varies over the region, which is
    what the LFFF cannot represent. Dark grey = weak field (α not
    defined).
    """
    names = list(models)
    maps, zs = {}, {}
    for n in names:
        f = models[n]
        iz = int(np.argmin(np.abs(f.z - z)))
        maps[n] = f.alpha()[:, :, iz]
        zs[n] = f.z[iz]
    if vlim is None:
        allv = np.concatenate([np.abs(m[np.isfinite(m)]) for m in maps.values()])
        vlim = float(np.percentile(allv, 98)) if allv.size else 1.0
        vlim = vlim or 1.0
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, len(names), figsize=(4.2 * len(names) + 1, 5.2),
                             layout="constrained", squeeze=False)
    for ax, n in zip(axes[0], names):
        f = models[n]
        x, y = f.x, f.y
        ax.imshow(maps[n].T, origin="lower", cmap=DIV_CMAP, vmin=-vlim, vmax=vlim,
                  extent=(*_edges(x), *_edges(y)), interpolation="nearest")
        _draw_bz_2d(ax, x, y, f.bz[:, :, 0], _bz_vlim(f.bz[:, :, 0]), image=False)
        m = maps[n][np.isfinite(maps[n])]
        sub = f"⟨α⟩ = {m.mean():.3g},  σ = {m.std():.2g} Mm⁻¹" if m.size else ""
        ax.set_title(f"{n}\n{sub}")
        ax.set_xlabel("x [Mm]")
        ax.set_aspect("equal")
    axes[0, 0].set_ylabel("y [Mm]")
    fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(Normalize(-vlim, vlim), DIV_CMAP), ax=axes[0].tolist(),
                 shrink=0.85, label="α = (∇×B)·B / B²  [Mm⁻¹]")
    fig.suptitle(_t("alpha_sup", z=zs[names[0]]), fontsize=11)
    fig.text(0.5, 0.0, _t("alpha_foot"), ha="center", va="bottom", fontsize=8.5, color=INK2)
    if save:
        fig.savefig(save, dpi=150)
    return fig

def line_alpha_stats(field: VectorField3D, lines: list[FieldLine],
                     min_height_cells: float = 2.0):
    """Mean and standard deviation of α along each line (excludes the lowest layers).

    In a force-free field α is constant on each line: a small
    deviation from the mean indicates good quality.
    """
    a = field.alpha()
    origin = np.asarray(field.origin)
    means, stds = np.full(len(lines), np.nan), np.full(len(lines), np.nan)
    for i, l in enumerate(lines):
        idx = ((l.points - origin) / field.dx).T
        keep = idx[2] >= min_height_cells
        if keep.sum() < 3:
            continue
        v = map_coordinates(a, idx[:, keep], order=0, mode="nearest", cval=np.nan)
        v = v[np.isfinite(v)]
        if v.size >= 3:
            means[i], stds[i] = v.mean(), v.std()
    return means, stds

def plot_alpha_histogram(models: dict[str, VectorField3D], seeds: np.ndarray,
                         reference: str | None = None, save: str | None = None):
    """Distribution of α per field line (left) and its constancy along
    the line (right), with the same seeds for every model."""
    names = list(models)
    cols = _model_colors(names, reference)
    stats = {n: line_alpha_stats(models[n], trace_field_lines(models[n], seeds)) for n in names}
    allm = np.concatenate([s[0][np.isfinite(s[0])] for s in stats.values()])
    lo = min(float(np.percentile(allm, 1)), 0.0) if allm.size else -1.0
    hi = max(float(np.percentile(allm, 99)), 0.0) if allm.size else 1.0
    pad = 0.1 * (hi - lo or 1.0)
    bins = np.linspace(lo - pad, hi + pad, 41)
    alls = np.concatenate([s[1][np.isfinite(s[1])] for s in stats.values()])
    sbins = np.linspace(0, float(np.percentile(alls, 99)) * 1.1 if alls.size else 1.0, 31)

    fig, (ax1, ax2) = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(11, 4), layout="constrained")
    for n in names:
        m, s = stats[n]
        ls = "--" if n == reference else "-"
        ax1.hist(m[np.isfinite(m)], bins=bins, histtype="step", lw=2, color=cols[n], ls=ls, label=n)
        ax2.hist(s[np.isfinite(s)], bins=sbins, histtype="step", lw=2, color=cols[n], ls=ls, label=n)
    ax1.axvline(0, color=MUTED, lw=0.8, zorder=0)
    ax1.set_xlabel(_t("alpha_mean"))

    ax1.set_title(_t("alpha_q1"))

@_styled
def plot_error_maps(models: dict[str, VectorField3D], reference: str,
                    heights=(5.0, 15.0, 30.0), b_min_frac: float = 0.01,
                    save: str | None = None):
    """Angle between the model B and the reference B on horizontal slices.

    Rows: models; columns: heights (Mm). In each panel, ⟨θ⟩_B is the mean
    weighted by |B_ref| (dominated by the strong field).
    """
    ref = models[reference]
    others = [n for n in models if n != reference]
    izs = [int(np.argmin(np.abs(ref.z - h))) for h in heights]
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(len(others), len(izs),
                             figsize=(3.6 * len(izs) + 1.2, 3.3 * len(others) + 0.6),
                             layout="constrained", squeeze=False)
    bmax = ref.babs.max()
    for i, n in enumerate(others):
        f = models[n]
        for j, iz in enumerate(izs):
            B = np.stack([ref.bx[:, :, iz], ref.by[:, :, iz], ref.bz[:, :, iz]])
            b = np.stack([f.bx[:, :, iz], f.by[:, :, iz], f.bz[:, :, iz]])
            nB, nb = np.linalg.norm(B, axis=0), np.linalg.norm(b, axis=0)
            with np.errstate(invalid="ignore", divide="ignore"):
                ang = np.degrees(np.arccos(np.clip((B * b).sum(0) / (nB * nb), -1, 1)))
            ang[nB < b_min_frac * bmax] = np.nan
            ax = axes[i, j]
            ax.imshow(ang.T, origin="lower", cmap=SEQ_CMAP, vmin=0, vmax=90,
                      extent=(*_edges(ref.x), *_edges(ref.y)), interpolation="nearest")
            _draw_bz_2d(ax, ref.x, ref.y, ref.bz[:, :, 0], _bz_vlim(ref.bz[:, :, 0]),
                        image=False, contours=False)
            ok = np.isfinite(ang)
            wmean = (ang[ok] * nB[ok]).sum() / nB[ok].sum() if ok.any() else np.nan
            ax.text(0.03, 0.97, f"⟨θ⟩_B = {wmean:.1f}°", transform=ax.transAxes, va="top",
                    fontsize=8.5, color=INK, bbox=dict(fc=SURFACE, ec="none", alpha=0.85, pad=2))
            ax.set_aspect("equal")
            if i == 0:
                ax.set_title(f"z = {ref.z[iz]:.1f} Mm")
            if j == 0:
                ax.set_ylabel(f"{n}\ny [Mm]")
            if i == len(others) - 1:
                ax.set_xlabel("x [Mm]")
    fig.colorbar(ScalarMappable(Normalize(0, 90), SEQ_CMAP), ax=axes.ravel().tolist(),
                 shrink=0.8, label=_t("angle_cb", ref=reference))
    fig.suptitle(_t("err_sup"),
                 fontsize=10, color=INK2)
    if save:
        fig.savefig(save, dpi=150)
    return fig

docs.title: solarff.aia
docs.text:
Comparison of the field lines with the coronal loops observed by SDO/AIA.

External validation with real data (as in Warren et al. 2018): the model lines are projected onto an AIA EUV image and the misalignment angle between the tangent of the projected line and the local orientation of the bright structures of the image (loops) is measured point by point.

Steps:

  1. download_aia — level-1 image closest to the HMI observation (aia.lev1_euv_12s, requires drms and an email registered at JSOC, which is only passed as an argument and never stored).
  2. project_points — from the local Cartesian coordinates of the model (x, y, z in Mm on the CEA projection of the SHARP) to AIA pixels: CEA → Carrington (longitude, latitude) with the WCS of the SHARP, radius R☉ + z, and transformation to the SDO viewpoint with sunpy.coordinates. The Cartesian box is a local (flat) approximation of the sphere, the usual one in NLFFF with SHARP CEA.
  3. ridge_orientation — local orientation of the bright ridges (loops) from the Hessian matrix of the smoothed image: the direction of the loop is the eigenvector of the eigenvalue of smallest modulus, and the ridge strength is −λ_min (negative curvature = bright ridge).
  4. line_misalignment — for each line, median of the angle between its projected tangent and the ridge orientation at the points where there is a clear ridge (above a strength percentile).

The angle lies in [0°, 90°] (orientations have no sense); a line unrelated to the image gives 45° on average.

download_aia(time_utc: str, wavelengths=(171, 193), email: str | None = None, out_dir: str = 'data/aia', window: str = '2m') -> dict

Download the level-1 AIA image closest to time_utc for each wavelength.

time_utc: ISO time in UTC (the HMI T_REC are in TAI: in 2011 TAI − UTC = 34 s). Records within ±window with QUALITY = 0 are searched and the one with the closest T_OBS is chosen. Returns {wavelength: path}. If the file already exists it is not downloaded again.

def download_aia(time_utc: str, wavelengths=(171, 193), email: str | None = None,
                 out_dir: str = "data/aia", window: str = "2m") -> dict:
    """Download the level-1 AIA image closest to ``time_utc`` for each wavelength.

    ``time_utc``: ISO time in UTC (the HMI T_REC are in TAI: in 2011
    TAI − UTC = 34 s). Records within ±``window`` with QUALITY = 0 are searched and
    the one with the closest T_OBS is chosen. Returns ``{wavelength: path}``. If the
    file already exists it is not downloaded again.
    """
    import drms
    import pandas as pd
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    t = pd.Timestamp(time_utc.replace("Z", ""))
    half = pd.Timedelta(window) if window[-1] != "m" else pd.Timedelta(minutes=int(window[:-1]))
    q0 = (t - half).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    span = f"{int(2 * half.total_seconds())}s"
    c = drms.Client(email=email) if email else drms.Client()
    out = {}
    for w in wavelengths:
        k = c.query(f"{AIA_SERIES}[{q0}/{span}][{w}]", key="T_REC,T_OBS,QUALITY")
        k = k[k.QUALITY == 0].copy()
        if k.empty:
            raise RuntimeError(f"No hay imágenes AIA {w} Å con QUALITY = 0 cerca de {time_utc}")
        k["dt"] = (pd.to_datetime(k.T_OBS.str.replace("Z", "")) - t).abs()
        rec = k.sort_values("dt").iloc[0]
        tag = rec.T_REC.replace(":", "").replace("-", "")
        existing = glob.glob(os.path.join(out_dir, f"*{w}*{tag[:15]}*.fits"))
        if existing:
            out[w] = existing[0]
            continue
        if not email:
            raise ValueError("Hace falta un email registrado en JSOC para descargar (argumento email)")
        r = c.export(f"{AIA_SERIES}[{rec.T_REC}][{w}]{{image}}", method="url", protocol="fits")
        r.wait()
        d = r.download(out_dir)
        path = d.download[0]
        new = os.path.join(out_dir, f"aia.lev1_euv_12s.{w}.{tag}.fits")
        os.replace(path, new)
        out[w] = new
    return out

def load_aia(path: str):
    """sunpy Map of a level-1 AIA image, normalised by the exposure time."""
    import sunpy.map
    m = sunpy.map.Map(path)
    exp = float(m.meta.get("exptime", 1.0)) or 1.0
    return sunpy.map.Map(m.data.astype(float) / exp, m.meta)

def sharp_wcs(sharp_fits: str):
    """WCS and header of a SHARP CEA segment (e.g. the Br one)."""
    from astropy.io import fits
    from astropy.wcs import WCS
    with fits.open(sharp_fits) as hd:
        h = hd[1].header if len(hd) > 1 and hd[1].data is not None else hd[0].header
    return WCS(h), h

def project_points(points_mm: np.ndarray, sharp_fits: str, aia_map) -> np.ndarray:
    """AIA pixels (x, y) of points (N, 3) in Mm of the model (x, y on the CEA, z height).

    The native pixel of the SHARP is ``x / dx0`` with ``dx0 = CDELT1 · R☉`` (the
    convention of ``solarff.io.load_sharp_cea``, also after ``rebin``).
    """
    import astropy.units as u
    from astropy.coordinates import SkyCoord
    from sunpy.coordinates import frames
    w, h = sharp_wcs(sharp_fits)
    rsun_mm = float(h.get("RSUN_REF", 6.96e8)) / 1e6
    dx0 = np.deg2rad(float(h["CDELT1"])) * rsun_mm
    p = np.asarray(points_mm, float)
    lon, lat = w.wcs_pix2world(p[:, 0] / dx0, p[:, 1] / dx0, 0)
    obs = aia_map.observer_coordinate
    c = SkyCoord(lon * u.deg, lat * u.deg, (rsun_mm + p[:, 2]) * u.Mm,
                 frame=frames.HeliographicCarrington(observer=obs, obstime=aia_map.date))
    px, py = aia_map.wcs.world_to_pixel(c.transform_to(aia_map.coordinate_frame))
    return np.column_stack([px, py])

ridge_orientation(img: ndarray, sigma: float = 2.0, log: bool = True)

Orientation (rad, in [0, π)) and strength of the bright ridges of an image.

Hessian of the image (of its logarithm, by default) smoothed with a Gaussian of width sigma pixels. On a bright ridge the transverse curvature is strongly negative (λ_min ≪ 0) and the longitudinal one nearly zero: the ridge direction is the eigenvector of λ_max. Strength = max(−λ_min, 0). img[row=y, column=x]; the angle is measured from +x.

Source code in solarff/aia.py 
def ridge_orientation(img: np.ndarray, sigma: float = 2.0, log: bool = True):
    """Orientation (rad, in [0, π)) and strength of the bright ridges of an image.

    Hessian of the image (of its logarithm, by default) smoothed with a
    Gaussian of width ``sigma`` pixels. On a bright ridge the transverse
    curvature is strongly negative (λ_min ≪ 0) and the longitudinal one nearly
    zero: the ridge direction is the eigenvector of λ_max. Strength =
    max(−λ_min, 0). ``img[row=y, column=x]``; the angle is measured from +x.
    """
    from scipy.ndimage import gaussian_filter
    a = np.log(np.clip(img, np.nanpercentile(img, 1) + 1e-3, None)) if log else img.astype(float)
    a = np.nan_to_num(a)
    hxx = gaussian_filter(a, sigma, order=(0, 2))
    hyy = gaussian_filter(a, sigma, order=(2, 0))
    hxy = gaussian_filter(a, sigma, order=(1, 1))
    tr, det = hxx + hyy, hxx * hyy - hxy * hxy
    disc = np.sqrt(np.maximum(tr * tr / 4 - det, 0))
    lmin = tr / 2 - disc
    lmax = tr / 2 + disc
    # eigenvector of lmax: (hxy, lmax − hxx) or (lmax − hyy, hxy); the one with the larger norm is taken
    # (one of the two vanishes when the Hessian is diagonal)
    ax, ay = hxy, lmax - hxx
    bx, by = lmax - hyy, hxy
    use_a = ax * ax + ay * ay >= bx * bx + by * by
    theta = np.mod(np.arctan2(np.where(use_a, ay, by), np.where(use_a, ax, bx)), np.pi)
    strength = np.maximum(-lmin, 0.0) * sigma ** 2  # scale-normalised
    return theta, strength

Median misalignment angle (degrees) of each projected line.

pix_lines: list of (N, 2) arrays of AIA pixels. Each line is resampled every step_px pixels along its projection; the points with ridge strength ≥ threshold are used. Lines with fewer than min_points valid points give NaN.

Source code in solarff/aia.py 
def line_misalignment(pix_lines: list, theta: np.ndarray, strength: np.ndarray, threshold: float,
                      min_points: int = 5, step_px: float = 2.0) -> np.ndarray:
    """Median misalignment angle (degrees) of each projected line.

    ``pix_lines``: list of (N, 2) arrays of AIA pixels. Each line is
    resampled every ``step_px`` pixels along its projection; the points with
    ridge strength ≥ ``threshold`` are used. Lines with fewer than
    ``min_points`` valid points give NaN.
    """
    out = np.full(len(pix_lines), np.nan)
    for k, P in enumerate(pix_lines):
        if len(P) < 3:
            continue
        seg = np.hypot(*np.diff(P, axis=0).T)
        s = np.concatenate([[0], np.cumsum(seg)])
        if s[-1] < 3 * step_px:
            continue
        si = np.arange(0, s[-1], step_px)
        x, y = np.interp(si, s, P[:, 0]), np.interp(si, s, P[:, 1])
        tx, ty = np.gradient(x), np.gradient(y)
        ang = np.mod(np.arctan2(ty, tx), np.pi)
        th, st = _sample(theta, x, y), _sample(strength, x, y)
        ok = np.isfinite(th) & (st >= threshold) & (np.hypot(tx, ty) > 1e-6)
        if ok.sum() < min_points:
            continue
        d = np.abs(ang[ok] - th[ok])
        d = np.minimum(d, np.pi - d)
        out[k] = np.degrees(np.median(d))
    return out

Compare the lines of a model with the AIA loops (see the module docstring).

lines: model lines (objects with points and apex); conf and reliable: their confidence; files: {wavelength: AIA FITS}; other_lines: {name: lines traced from the same seeds in other models (e.g. potential)}. Returns {"summary": ..., "plot": ...}: the summary (JSON) and what the figure needs.

Since in a region the confidence is usually strongly tied to the height of the line, the comparison is repeated at equal height (terciles of the maximum height) and with a regression angle ~ reliable + log(1 + height).

Source code in solarff/aia.py 
def aia_validation(lines, conf, reliable, files: dict, sharp_fits: str, other_lines: dict | None = None,
                   sigma: float = 2.0, pct: float = 90, n_boot: int = 2000, seed: int = 0) -> dict:
    """Compare the lines of a model with the AIA loops (see the module docstring).

    ``lines``: model lines (objects with ``points`` and ``apex``); ``conf`` and
    ``reliable``: their confidence; ``files``: {wavelength: AIA FITS};
    ``other_lines``: {name: lines traced from the same seeds in other
    models (e.g. potential)}. Returns ``{"summary": ..., "plot": ...}``:
    the summary (JSON) and what the figure needs.

    Since in a region the confidence is usually strongly tied to the height of the
    line, the comparison is repeated at equal height (terciles of the maximum
    height) and with a regression angle ~ reliable + log(1 + height).
    """
    from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu, spearmanr
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    other_lines = other_lines or {}
    conf = np.asarray(conf, float)
    rel = np.asarray(reliable, bool)
    apex = np.array([l.apex for l in lines])
    S = {"n_lines": len(lines), "reliable_frac": float(rel.mean()), "sigma_px": sigma, "ridge_pct": pct,
         "by_wavelength": {}}
    plot = {}
    for w, path in files.items():
        m = load_aia(path)
        pix = [project_points(np.asarray(l.points), sharp_fits, m) for l in lines]
        allp = np.vstack(pix)
        x0, y0 = np.maximum(np.floor(allp.min(0) - 30).astype(int), 0)
        x1, y1 = np.ceil(allp.max(0) + 30).astype(int)
        sub = m.data[y0:y1, x0:x1]
        shift = np.array([x0, y0])
        pl = [p - shift for p in pix]
        th, st = ridge_orientation(sub, sigma=sigma)
        thr = float(np.percentile(st, pct))
        ang = line_misalignment(pl, th, st, thr)
        ang_o = {k: line_misalignment([project_points(np.asarray(l.points), sharp_fits, m) - shift for l in ls],
                                      th, st, thr) for k, ls in other_lines.items()}
        ok = np.isfinite(ang)
        r = {"file": os.path.basename(path), "date": m.date.isot, "n_measured": int(ok.sum()),
             "median_reliable": float(np.nanmedian(ang[rel])), "median_unreliable": float(np.nanmedian(ang[~rel])),
             "n_reliable": int((ok & rel).sum()), "n_unreliable": int((ok & ~rel).sum())}
        r["diff"], r["diff_ci"] = _boot_median_diff(ang[rel], ang[~rel], n_boot, rng)
        r["p_mannwhitney"] = float(mannwhitneyu(ang[ok & rel], ang[ok & ~rel], alternative="less").pvalue)
        r["spearman_conf"] = float(spearmanr(conf[ok], ang[ok])[0])
        # Height control
        la = np.log1p(apex[ok])
        X = np.column_stack([np.ones(ok.sum()), rel[ok].astype(float), la])
        y = ang[ok]
        beta = np.linalg.lstsq(X, y, rcond=None)[0]
        bs = [np.linalg.lstsq(X[i], y[i], rcond=None)[0][1]
              for i in (rng.integers(0, y.size, y.size) for _ in range(n_boot))]
        r["ols_reliable"] = float(beta[1])
        r["ols_reliable_ci"] = [float(np.percentile(bs, 2.5)), float(np.percentile(bs, 97.5))]
        Z = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(la), la])
        res_c = conf[ok] - Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, conf[ok], rcond=None)[0]
        res_a = y - Z @ np.linalg.lstsq(Z, y, rcond=None)[0]
        r["spearman_partial"] = float(spearmanr(res_c, res_a)[0])
        r["spearman_partial_p"] = float(spearmanr(res_c, res_a)[1])
        q = np.percentile(apex[ok], [100 / 3, 200 / 3])
        terc = np.digitize(apex, q)
        r["terciles"] = []
        for i in range(3):
            s = ok & (terc == i)
            row = {"apex_mm": [float(apex[s].min()), float(apex[s].max())],
                   "n_reliable": int((s & rel).sum()), "n_unreliable": int((s & ~rel).sum()),
                   "median_reliable": float(np.median(ang[s & rel])) if (s & rel).any() else None,
                   "median_unreliable": float(np.median(ang[s & ~rel])) if (s & ~rel).any() else None}
            if row["n_reliable"] >= 5 and row["n_unreliable"] >= 5:
                row["diff"], row["diff_ci"] = _boot_median_diff(ang[s & rel], ang[s & ~rel], n_boot, rng)
            for k, v in ang_o.items():
                row[f"nlfff_minus_{k}_reliable"] = _paired((ang - v)[s & rel])
                row[f"nlfff_minus_{k}_unreliable"] = _paired((ang - v)[s & ~rel])
            r["terciles"].append(row)
        r["models"] = {}
        for k, v in ang_o.items():
            b = ok & np.isfinite(v)
            r["models"][k] = {"all": _paired((ang - v)[b]), "reliable": _paired((ang - v)[b & rel]),
                              "unreliable": _paired((ang - v)[b & ~rel]),
                              "median_nlfff": float(np.median(ang[b])), "median_other": float(np.median(v[b]))}
        # Sensitivity to the loop detection
        sens = []
        for sg in (1.5, 2.0, 3.0):
            th2, st2 = (th, st) if sg == sigma else ridge_orientation(sub, sigma=sg)
            for pc in (85, 90, 95):
                a2 = line_misalignment(pl, th2, st2, float(np.percentile(st2, pc)))
                mid = np.isfinite(a2) & (terc == 1)
                sens.append({"sigma": sg, "pct": pc, "median_reliable": float(np.nanmedian(a2[rel])),
                             "median_unreliable": float(np.nanmedian(a2[~rel])),
                             "mid_reliable": float(np.nanmedian(a2[mid & rel])) if (mid & rel).any() else None,
                             "mid_unreliable": float(np.nanmedian(a2[mid & ~rel])) if (mid & ~rel).any() else None})
        r["sensitivity"] = sens
        S["by_wavelength"][str(w)] = r
        plot[w] = {"cutout": sub, "pix": pl, "angles": ang, "date": m.date.isot[:19]}
    return {"summary": S, "plot": {"wavelengths": plot, "reliable": rel}}
